review:
Halloween in the Coins series, on 9 reels with a 5,000x Grand Jackpot. Like the rest of the series, nearly everything builds towards the Hold the Jackpot respin bonus.

Cash Infinity symbols are worth more and stick until the bonus ends. A Cash Out label can attach in the base game, collecting values and paying a percentage when its countdown ends after up to 20 spins. Chance Level multiplies the bet by up to 10x to make the bonus more likely. Very high volatility, 96.15% RTP.
pros: Second route to big wins via respins or jackpots
Free demo available on the Wazdan website
cons: Very high volatility – long dry spells are normal
Short-session results can differ widely from the long-term average
